en: Qiu Qianren, at odds with Guo Jing, challenges him to a duel; Guo Jing holds that a former Jin lackey has no right to the Mount Hua Summit. Once Qiu is beaten, Hong Qigong and Huang Yaoshi both declare Guo Jing's kung fu the best in the world.
